signatureChanges.after: type key-order "The order packet.edn prints its top level in — `build-packet`'s own, plus what the validator records after it: the narrative's digest, the comprehension verdict, and :validation, at the end. It exists because a packet READ BACK from EDN is not the map that was written. A literal with more than eight pairs reads as a hash map and a sorted-map literal reads as an ordinary one, so anything that rewrites a packet (review-packet.validate records its verdict in one) would otherwise shuffle the top level and unsort :hunks. packet.edn is read by a person deciding whether the packet is right, and a shuffled one is a file nobody can skim."
